page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking and renting with RideOn.

items.q: How do I book a bike?
items.a: Select your pickup and return date and time, check availability, choose your available option, and complete the booking process.

items.q: How do I check bike availability?
items.a: Click Book Ride, select your required pickup and return time, and the available options will be shown.

items.q: Can I book a bike for a future date?
items.a: Yes, you can book for an available future date and time shown by RideOn.

items.q: Can I change my booking?
items.a: Booking changes are subject to availability and the applicable RideOn booking and cancellation rules.

items.q: How will I know my booking is confirmed?
items.a: After your booking is successfully completed, you will receive a booking confirmation with your rental details.

items.q: Who can rent a RideOn bike?
items.a: You must meet RideOn's eligibility requirements and have a valid driving licence required to legally ride the rented bike.

items.q: What documents do I need?
items.a: You may be required to provide your valid driving licence, identification, and other information required for verification.

items.q: Can someone else ride the bike I booked?
items.a: No. The bike is intended for the customer named on the booking unless RideOn specifically authorizes another rider.

items.q: Can I use the bike for racing or stunts?
items.a: No. Racing, stunt riding, overloading, and other prohibited uses are not allowed.

items.q: Can I ride the bike after consuming alcohol?
items.a: No. Riding under the influence of alcohol or drugs is strictly prohibited.

items.q: What rental options are available?
items.a: RideOn offers rental options based on the available pricing plans, including hourly, half-day, and daily options where applicable.

items.q: What is included in the rental price?
items.a: The booking summary will show the applicable rental charges, taxes, fees, and any included items or services before you complete your booking.

items.q: Is a security deposit required?
items.a: If a security deposit applies to your booking, the amount will be shown during the booking process.

items.q: When will I get my security deposit back?
items.a: The eligible security deposit amount will be processed after the bike is returned and any applicable deductions have been determined.

items.q: What payment methods can I use?
items.a: Available payment methods will be shown during the booking and payment process.

items.q: Where do I pick up the bike?
items.a: Your confirmed pickup location and instructions will be provided with your booking details.

items.q: What happens if I return the bike late?
items.a: A grace period may apply. After the applicable grace period, late-return charges may be applied according to RideOn's current policy.

items.q: Can I return the bike earlier than my booking time?
items.a: Yes, but returning the bike early does not automatically mean that unused rental time will be refunded. The applicable rule is determined by RideOn's policy.

items.q: What should I do if the bike breaks down?
items.a: Contact RideOn immediately. Do not attempt an unauthorized repair.

items.q: What should I do if the bike is damaged or involved in an accident?
items.a: Contact RideOn immediately and provide the necessary details. Do not leave the incident unreported.

items.q: Can I cancel my booking?
items.a: Yes. You can cancel your booking according to the RideOn Cancellation Policy.

items.q: How much will I get back if I cancel?
items.a: The applicable refund depends on how early you cancel before your scheduled pickup time. See our Cancellation Policy for the current cancellation charges.

items.q: When will my refund be processed?
items.a: If your cancellation qualifies for a refund, it will be processed according to the RideOn Cancellation Policy and applicable payment-provider processing times.

items.q: What happens if I don't show up for my booking?
items.a: A no-show may be subject to the applicable cancellation rules.

items.q: Do I get a helmet with the bike?
items.a: Helmet availability and any related charges are shown during the booking process where applicable.

items.q: Is there a kilometre limit?
items.a: Included kilometres (if any) are shown on the pricing plans and in your booking summary.

items.q: What happens if I exceed the included kilometres?
items.a: Additional kilometres may be charged according to the applicable RideOn pricing.

items.q: Who is responsible for traffic fines?
items.a: Traffic fines, challans, and applicable penalties resulting from the customer's use of the bike are the customer's responsibility.

items.q: What happens if I lose the bike key or an accessory?
items.a: Inform RideOn immediately. Applicable replacement or recovery charges may apply.

items.q: How can I contact RideOn?
items.a: You can contact our support team using the contact details provided on the Contact Us page.

items.q: I have a problem with my booking. What should I do?
items.a: Contact RideOn support and provide your booking ID and details of the issue. Our team will assist you.
